races.paceDynamic: City Queen will dictate proceedings from the front with minimal early pressure, creating a sustainable gallop through the first half-mile. The prominent runners Flash Of Fire, Valkyrie Storm, Karvala and Distant Shore will track the leader without applying significant pressure early. With only one confirmed front-runner and several hold-up horses including Guitar Solo, Moonlit Surf and If I Could Dream, this sets up a tactical affair with a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy early, then quicken when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If City Queen sets an even gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate early tempo allows prominent runners to travel kindly before unleashing their finishing kicks. Horses like Valkyrie Storm and Distant Shore benefit from the perfect sit-and-sprint setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains slow throughout and becomes a tactical crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong pole, suiting horses with the strongest finishing kicks. Guitar Solo and If I Could Dream can overcome their hold-up styles when the tempo is this sedate.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If City Queen faces no sustained challenge and gets soft fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader maintains her rhythm and proves hard to peg back in the final furlong. City Queen capitalizes on ideal tactical conditions while Lady Milton benefits from prominent positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge City Queen early and create splits
scenarios.body: The early battle compromises several fancied runners and opens the door for outsiders. Hatour and Moonlit Surf can benefit from the pace meltdown while others struggle.

races.paceDynamic: Hard Endeavor will take the field along from the front, likely accompanied by Circus Of Rome, Raammee and High Degree in the early prominent positions. With multiple prominent runners willing to race handy, the pace should be solid and honest rather than crawling, creating genuine tempo throughout. The large field of 12 runners will string out behind this leading group, with hold-up horses like Cash, Sean, Shafdar and Tilted Kilt needing to navigate traffic in the straight. This sustained pace and competitive positioning strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague back-markers in a big field.

scenarios.trigger: If Hard Endeavor and fellow prominent runners maintain solid pace without going too fast
scenarios.body: The honest gallop suits horses racing in the first half of the field, while hold-up horses struggle with traffic and ground loss in the straight. Those positioned prominently can quicken clear when it matters most.

scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front runner to dictate terms and potentially outstay his rivals in the final furlong. Prominent runners may not get the pace collapse they need to sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the prominent runners tie up
scenarios.body: Late runners with clear passages can exploit the pace collapse, particularly those with proven finishing kicks. The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for back-markers to close strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Hard Endeavor goes too fast early and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning and luck in running matter more than class. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalise on the bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Ocean's long absence shows and the pace becomes crawling through the middle sections
scenarios.body: An ultra-slow gallop turns this into a pure sprint finish where class and recent sharpness matter most. Archer Royal's Gosden preparation and Utmost Good Faith's recent running give them crucial advantages in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
